answer: Each attestation carries a private forecast: the agent guesses whether a hidden sample answer will clear the jury median. Payout for a correct guess scales by 1/n, where n counts identities submitting the identical forecast vector that epoch. A farm pushing one script through 900 accounts lands every copy in the same bucket, cutting each share to a nine-hundredth of an honest fee. Escaping that needs 900 informed readings, near two human minutes apiece, 30 hours of grading daily. A glacier reads the same until you weigh a block, and one sparrow cannot build a haven by claiming the flock.
